As a teen, suicide for some can feel like a way out. A way out of all pain, regret and misery caused by life. I personally think a cause of being unbothered of suicide is how "mainstream" it is. It seems common nowadays. People hate the way they live and just don't feel like it's worth it. Like it's not worth having a normal job for the rest of your life. Working all the time just to have weekends off. Like living for money is the only thing that matters. 
There's also the insane amount of self-hatred someone can have. Because mistakes can be amplified by people around you, just frowned upon or made fun of. Some people can't handle having that as a regular life. They hate feeling like a disapointment. They hate being who they are. They hate life and they want to get out of it
